title: Paloma and the Confession
author: Orsen Winterbourne
blurb: Sable Ashgrove, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
